name: nanochat
statusSub: Tier 1 passed; independent Tier 2 stopped at the certification spend ceiling
blocker: The cold attempt completed base training and began supervised fine-tuning, but projected completion exceeded the $25 certification NTE. The sole allowed attempt was stopped and did not complete the rebuild.
summary: A full upstream-horizon depth-14 nanochat run completed on one 96 GB Blackwell GPU, including pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, evaluation, packaging, and public artifact upload. The public lineage passes Tier 1: strict clean-DAG 14/14, AI-BOM 100/100, every public URL resolves, and the dependency freeze is portable. An independent cold Tier-2 attempt regenerated the full base-training checkpoint and began supervised fine-tuning, then stopped when projected completion exceeded the certification spend ceiling. The row remains reproducible but is not certified.
experimentUrlNote: No public experiment link is asserted because the uploaded metric series was not independently resolved from the public viewer.

issues.title: The default attention-kernel selection includes unsupported GPU architectures
issues.detail: The published loader selects a Flash Attention 3 kernel for every CUDA compute major other than Hopper, including Blackwell sm_120. On the recorded accelerator that path is unsupported; the run needs the existing SDPA fallback instead.
issues.fix: select FA3 only for compute majors with an explicitly supported kernel and otherwise use SDPA

agentSteps.evidence: campaign queue issue 24 depth-16 terminal report

certification.stepsNote: The reproduction emitted no Steps run: N/M summary before the evidence-preserving stop.
certification.manifestDiff: 29/29 exact against the union of all recorded job manifests; 47 distributions installed. uv pip freeze and importlib.metadata independently agreed at 47. No recorded pin was missing or mismatched.
certification.venvResolution: The executed interpreter resolved to Python 3.12.10 from the rebuilt virtual environment. PATH and VIRTUAL_ENV selected that environment, and loaded CUDA libraries came from its site-packages.
certification.blocker: Projected completion exceeded the $25 certification NTE after base training completed and supervised fine-tuning began; the sole allowed attempt was stopped before a complete rebuild.
certification.certifiedBy: independent cold certification agent; did not capture or modify the workload
